summary_zh:
冰島南岸的胸罩圍欄（Bra Fence）位於霍爾茨湖（Lake Holtsós）附近，介於塞里雅蘭瀑布（Seljalandsfoss）和斯科加瀑布（Skógafoss）之間，靠近Steinahellir洞穴。

這個圍欄自2012年起，吸引了大量遊客和當地人前來參觀並掛上胸罩，成為冰島南部獨特的景點之一。
起源與意義

胸罩圍欄的起源眾說紛紜。一種說法是，某次聚會後，一些人將胸罩掛在圍欄上，之後這一行為逐漸演變成一種傳統。

另一種說法是，圍欄上的胸罩數量逐年增加，成為一種自發的社區藝術表現。
此外，有人認為胸罩圍欄象徵著女性解放和勇氣，成為冰島南部的一個獨特地標。
summary_en: Bra Fence, located near Lake Holtsós on Iceland’s South Coast between Seljalandsfoss and Skógafoss and close to the Steinahellir cave, is a quirky roadside attraction where visitors hang bras on a fence. Parking is available for free on site. There are no restroom facilities, so plan accordingly. A visit typically takes about 30 minutes; allow extra time for parking and walking to the fence. Enjoy the unique local art and take photos, but be mindful of the natural environment and respect any posted guidelines.
